y-m-27-03.s.s3.r.d: Uma ubhala wena okungu-12 okubaliwe ngokuphindaphinda, uzobona izinombolo ezingenakwenziwa.
y-m-27-03.s.s3.explain: Uma uphindaphinda izindlela ezingu-4 zendawo yamashumi ngezindlela ezingu-3 zendawo yabodwa, izinombolo ezisebenzisa ikhadi elifanayo kabili, njengo-22 no-44, zixutshwe kokungu-12. y-m-27-04.title: Ukubala '20 izindlela' kufanelana nazo zonke izinhlobo zokukhetha?
y-m-27-04.topic: Inani lamacala: ukukhetha okuhlukanisa ukulandelana nokungahlukanisi
y-m-27-04.goal: Thola ukuthi kungani ukubala okufanayo kunika imiphumela ehlukile lapho abantu abakhethiwe benemisebenzi ehlukile nalapho bengenayo, futhi ulungise inani lezindlela ngokubala ukuthi inhlanganisela eyodwa yabalwa izikhathi ezingaki.
y-m-27-04.material:
Kubantu abangu-5 beqembu lokuhlabelela (가온, 나리, 다솜, 라온, 마루), imisebenzi emibili kumele inqunywe.
(A) Khetha umengameli o-1 nesekela likamengameli o-1. Umuntu oyedwa akakwazi ukubamba zombili izikhundla.
(B) Khetha amalungu angu-2 emisebenzi yokuhlanza inkundla. Akukho mehluko emsebenzini owenziwa abantu ababili abakhethiwe.
U-Eunu wazixazulula zombili imisebenzi njengo-"izindlela ezingu-5×4=20". Isixazululo sika-Eunu siqhubeka kanje.
y-m-27-04.thinking.2: Ukubala nokulungisa inani lezikhathi okubalwe ngakho kabili
y-m-27-04.prereq.1: Ukuhlangabezana nokulandisa wonke amacala ngokushintsha amagama abantu ngezimpawu
y-m-27-04.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa esixazululweni sika-Eunu onzima ukuwukholwa.
y-m-27-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ku-(A) no-(B), sebenza ukuthi ukushintshanisa abantu ababili abakhethiwe kwenza umehluko noma kuyafana.
y-m-27-04.s.s1.hint.1: Fushanisa amagama abe 가, 나, 다, 라, 마 futhi uqhathanise ukuthi u-(가, 나) no-(나, 가) liyicala elifanayo ku-(A) nasku-(B).
y-m-27-04.s.s1.line.1: Uma umengameli esenqunyiwe, abantu abangaba yisekela likamengameli bangabanye abangu-4. Ngakho u-(A) uyizindlela ezingu-5×4=20.
y-m-27-04.s.s1.line.2: Ku-(B) nakho, kunezindlela ezingu-5 zokukhetha umuntu wokuqala kuqala, bese kuba nezindlela ezingu-4 zokukhetha umuntu wesibili.
y-m-27-04.s.s1.line.3: Ngakho u-(B) naye uyizindlela ezingu-5×4=20, futhi amanani ezindlela ze-(A) ne-(B) ayafana.
y-m-27-04.s.s1.explain: Imigqa 1 no-2 ilungile. Umengameli nesekela likamengameli yimisebenzi ehlukile, ngakho (가온 umengameli, 나리 isekela likamengameli) no-(나리 umengameli, 가온 isekela likamengameli) amacala ahlukile, futhi izindlela ezingu-20 zilungile. Inkinga iqala emgqeni 3. Ku-(B) akukho mehluko emisebenzini, ngakho u-(가온, 나리) no-(나리, 가온) ngenhlanganisela yomsebenzi efanayo, kodwa uma ubala ngo-5×4 ubala lezi ezimbili ngokuhlukile futhi ubale inhlanganisela eyodwa kabili. Ngakho isiphetho emgqeni 4 sokuthi '(A) no-(B) ayafana' siphosile nakho.
y-m-27-04.s.s2.prompt: Ngezindlela ezingaki ngokuphelele ongakhetha ngazo amalungu angu-2 emisebenzi yokuhlanza inkundla ku-(B)?
y-m-27-04.s.s2.hint.0: Fushanisa amagama abe yizimpawu futhi ulandise izinhlanganisela ngokulandelana, uqale ngalezo eziqukethe u-가.
y-m-27-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bala ukuthi inhlanganisela eyodwa (isibonelo, 가온 no-나리) iqukethwe izikhathi ezingaki ezindleleni ezingu-20.
y-m-27-04.s.s2.r.a: Leli yinani elibalwe ngo-5×4. Hlola ukuthi ubale amacala lapho abantu ababili abakhethiwe bashintshaniswa ngokuhlukile.
y-m-27-04.s.s2.r.b: Lokhu kubonakala njengenani elibala kuphela amacala okukhetha umuntu oyedwa. Landisa wena amacala okukhethwa abantu ababili.
y-m-27-04.s.s2.r.c: Lokhu kuwukubala okubala abantu abafanayo ababili ngokushintshana kokulandelana kuphela njengeyodwa.
y-m-27-04.s.s2.r.d: Leli yinani elibale nokukhetha umuntu ofanayo kabili. Amalungu angu-2 emisebenzi kumele abe ngabantu abahlukile.
y-m-27-04.s.s2.explain: 5×4=20 yinani elibale abantu abafanayo ababili ngokushintshana kokulandelana kuphela, njengo-(가온, 나리) no-(나리, 가온), ngokuhlukile. Inhlanganisela ngayinye yomsebenzi yabalwa kabili, ngakho kungu-20÷2=10 izindlela. Uma ulandisa ngqo njengo-가나, 가다, 가라, 가마, 나다, 나라, 나마, 다라, 다마, 라마, nakho kungu-10 izindlela.
y-m-27-04.s.s3.prompt: Uma u-(B) eshintshwa abe "amalungu angu-3 emisebenzi", ngezindlela ezingaki ngokuphelele ongakhetha abantu abangu-3 kwabangu-5? (Akukho mehluko emisebenzini.)
y-m-27-04.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala phansi wonke ukulandelana lapho abantu abathathu 가, 나, 다 bangahlela khona futhi ubale ukuthi zingaki izindlela.
y-m-27-04.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi uthola inani elifanayo uma uhlukanisa amacala ngokuthi ngubani ongakhethwanga.
y-m-27-04.s.s3.r.a: Leli yinani elisebenzelwe ngokuthi abantu abafanayo abathathu babalwa izikhathi ezingaki. Uthola inani elifanayo uma ucabanga ngokuya ngabantu abangakhethwanga.
y-m-27-04.s.s3.r.b: Leli yinani elame ngemuva kokubala u-5×4×3. Hlola ukuthi ubale abantu abafanayo abathathu izikhathi eziningi ngokushintshana kokulandelana kuphela.
y-m-27-04.s.s3.r.c: Leli yinani elihlukaniswe ngo-2 kuphela njengasecaleni labantu abangu-2. Sebenza inani lokulandelana lapho abantu abathathu bangahlela khona.
y-m-27-04.s.s3.r.d: Leli yinani elisebenzise u-5×4 njengoba linjalo. Inqubo yokukhetha umuntu wesithathu ayikho.
y-m-27-04.s.s3.explain: 5×4×3=60 yinani elihlukanisa nokulandelana kokukhetha abantu abathathu. Ukulandelana lapho abantu abafanayo abathathu bangahlela khona kuyizindlela ezingu-3×2×1=6, ngakho inhlanganisela ngayinye ibalwa izikhathi ezingu-6. 60÷6=10 izindlela. Ukukhetha abantu abangu-3 kwabangu-5 kufana nokunquma abantu abangu-2 abangakhethwanga, ngakho kufana nezindlela ezingu-10 zokukhetha abantu abangu-2.

y-m-27-06.title: Inkinga yamabhola enezimpendulo ezihlukanayo ezimbili
y-m-27-06.topic: Ukubala ithuba: umehluko ngokuya ngokuthi into edwetshiwe ibuyiswa yini lapho udweba ngokulandelana
y-m-27-06.goal: Thola ukuthi isimo esiswelekayo enkingeni (ukuthi ibhola elidwetshiwe libuyiswa yini) sinquma impendulo, uqhathanise ithuba ngaphansi kwesimo ngasinye, futhi usebenze ukuthi umehluko phakathi kwezimo ezimbili ushintsha kanjani uma inani lamabhola lilikhulu.
y-m-27-06.material:
Isikhwama sibamba amabhola abomvu angu-3 namabhola aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka angu-2. Amabhola ahluka ngombala kuphela futhi anomumo nosayizi ofanayo, ngakho ngamehlo evaliwe awukwazi ukunquma ukuthi ibhola liphi eliyophuma. Ukhipha amabhola kulesi sikhwama linye ngesikhathi, kabili, futhi uhlola imibala.
Inkinga: "Ithuba lini lokuthi amabhola amabili akhishiwe anombala ofanayo?"
U-Eunseo waphendula u-13/25 futhi uDoyun waphendula u-2/5. Akekho kubo owenze iphutha ekubaleni ngendlela yakhe. Kodwa inkinga ayisho 'ukuthi ibhola elikhishiwe libuyiselwa esikhwameni yini'.
y-m-27-06.prereq.0: Ukuhlangabezana nokuthola ithuba lezinto ezenzeka izikhathi eziningana ngokulandelana

y-m-27-06.s.s1.r.a: Inkinga ayinawo amagama mayelana nokubuyisela. Cabanga ukuthi wengeze yini umcabango wena, ukubiza ngokuthi ngumthetho wasekuqaleni.
y-m-27-06.s.s1.o.b: Impendulo kaDoyun kuphela elungile. Ngokusobala ibhola elikhishiwe ligcinwa ngaphandle
y-m-27-06.s.s1.r.b: Inkinga ayinawo namagama mayelana nokungabuyiseli. Cabanga ukuthi ucabange njengokusobala yini.
y-m-27-06.s.s1.o.c: Bobabili baphosile. Kunemibala emibili, ngakho ithuba lombala ofanayo lingu-1/2
y-m-27-06.s.s1.r.c: Kunamabhola abomvu amaningi, ngakho imibala emibili ayiveli ngokulinganayo. Bheka inani lamabhola, hhayi inani lemibala.
y-m-27-06.s.s1.o.d: Akunakunqunywa ngaphandle kokwazi ukuthi ibhola elikhishiwe libuyiselwa yini
y-m-27-06.s.s1.r.d: Uqonde ukuthi isimo esiswelekayo sinquma impendulo. Kungaba kuhle ukuhlola ukuthi inani liphuma kanjani ngaphansi kwesimo ngasinye.
y-m-27-06.s.s1.explain: Uma ubuyisela, ekudwebeni kwesibili kusekunamabhola abomvu angu-3 nabhlue angu-2, ngakho (3/5)×(3/5)+(2/5)×(2/5)=13/25, futhi uma ungabuyiseli, kusele angu-4 ekudwebeni kwesibili, ngakho (3/5)×(2/4)+(2/5)×(1/4)=2/5. Amanani amabili ahlukile, ngakho ngaphandle kokwazi 'ukuthi libuyiselwa yini' awukwazi ukunquma.
y-m-27-06.s.s2.prompt: Yiziphi izimo ezidingwa yizimpendulo ezimbili ukuze zilunge?

y-m-27-06.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi izinombolo eziphezulu zethuba lesibili (inani lamabhola abomvu, inani lamabhola abhlue) ziyancika emphumeleni wokuqala yini.
y-m-27-06.s.s2.r.a: Ngamunye wahlulela ngokuthi inani lamabhola asele lapho ekhipha ibhola lesibili lingu-5 noma 4.

y-m-27-06.s.s2.r.c: Uma ubuyisela, okuhlukanisayo kuyafana, 5, lapho ukhipha ibhola lesibili nalo. Hlola okuhlukanisayo kukaDoyun.

y-m-27-06.s.s3.prompt: Uma wengeza izimbumbulu zibe ngu-30 ezibomvu no-20 eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka (isilinganiso siyafana, 3:2) bese uqhathanisa izimo ezimbili, kwenzekani emehlukweni phakathi kwamathuba amabili uma kuqhathaniswa nasekuqaleni (3 ezibomvu, 2 eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka)?
y-m-27-06.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala isihlukanisi sethuba lokukhipha isimbumbulu sesibili lapho singabuyiselwa, esimweni sokuqala nesimo esisha.
y-m-27-06.s.s3.hint.1: Bala amathuba ezimo ezimbili njengamadesimali bese uwaqhathanisa eceleni komunye nomunye nomehluko wokuqala.
y-m-27-06.s.s3.r.a: Qhathanisa ukuthi izimbumbulu ezisele ngemva kokukhipha esisodwa zincipha kangakanani uma inani lezimbumbulu likhulu.
y-m-27-06.s.s3.r.b: Noma isilinganiso siyafana, inani lezimbumbulu ezisele ngemva kokukhipha esisodwa lihlukile. Qhathanisa lapho izihlukanisi zingu-5 no-4 nalapho zingu-50 no-49.
y-m-27-06.s.s3.r.c: Uthole iphuzu lokuthi uma kunezimbumbulu eziningi, ukukhipha esisodwa kushintsha kancane okusele.
y-m-27-06.s.s3.r.d: Qhathanisa nokuthi inani lokuqala (2/5) belincane kuno-13/25. Bhala isibalo bese ubala ukuhlola.
y-m-27-06.s.s3.explain: Uma ubuyisela, (30/50)²+(20/50)²=13/25=0.52, futhi uma ungabuyiseli, (30/50)(29/49)+(20/50)(19/49)=25/49≈0.510, ngakho umehluko ungu-0.01 cishe. Ekuqaleni, kwakungu-13/25=0.52 no-2/5=0.4, umehluko ongu-0.12. y-m-27-01.title: Uma ithuba lemvula lalingu-70% futhi akuzange kuduma
y-m-27-01.topic: Incazelo yamathuba: ithuba lemvula nesilinganiso kudatha eqoqwe izikhathi eziningi
y-m-27-01.goal: Hlukanisa umphumela owodwa nethuba (ukwenzeka), wahlulele ukuthi isibikezelo sethenjwa kangakanani ngesilinganiso kudatha eqoqwe ezinsukwini eziningi, futhi, njalo uma kuvela idatha entsha, nquma ngezizathu ukuthi ugcina noma ubuyekeza isahlulelo sakho.
y-m-27-01.material:
Isibikezelo sezulu sithe 'kusasa ithuba lemvula ngu-70%', kodwa ngelanga elilandelayo akuzange kuduma. USeojin uthe, "Isibikezelo besingalungile," noHaeun uthe, "70% kusho ukuthi kuduma ngo-70% wamahora angu-24 osuku, cishe amahora ayi-17."
Kulo msebenzi, 'ithuba lemvula elingu-70%' lithathwa ukuthi 'uma kunezinsuku eziningi ezinezimo zesibikezelo ezifanayo, kuduma cishe ngo-70% wazo', futhi usuku lapho kuduma ngisho nokuncane lubalwa njengo-'usuku lapho kuduma'. Cabanga nangeqiniso lokuthi izibikezelo zezulu zingaba namaphutha. (70% ifundwa njengo-0.7, noma izikhathi eziyi-7 kweziyi-10.)

y-m-27-08.s.s4.o.c: Awukwazi ukwazi ukuthi likhulu noma lincane kuno-0.5 ngaphandle kokubala
y-m-27-08.s.s4.r.c: Ungahlola ngokubala. Kodwa, njengoba izimo zabo bobabili ziyafana ncamashi, ungacabanga nangokulinganisa.
y-m-27-08.s.s4.o.d: Ngu-0.5 ncamashi. Noma inani lemidlalo linyuka, akekho onomthelela
y-m-27-08.s.s4.r.d: Usebenzise iqiniso lokuthi liyafana noma izimo zabo bobabili zishintshiwe. Uma ubala 0.25+2×0.125, kungu-0.5 nakho.
y-m-27-08.s.s4.explain: Uma izinga lokunqoba lomdlalo owodwa liyafana, u-2:0 ngu-0.5×0.5=0.25, u-2:1 ngu-2×0.5×0.5×0.5=0.25, futhi isamba singu-0.5. Izimo zabo bobabili ziyafana ncamashi, ngakho ithuba lokuthi noma ngubani anqobe liyafana. Ukwandisa inani lemidlalo kunikeza umthelela ku-'uhlangothi olunezinga eliphakeme lokunqoba emdlalweni owodwa'; inani lemidlalo ngokwalo alinaki muntu.
